key_insight: Robust reinforcement learning learned adaptive treatment policies that outperformed an existing adaptive therapy method in simulated metastatic prostate cancer despite biomarker errors and shifts in disease dynamics.
clinical_relevance: The approach could inform more reliable treatment adaptation in precision oncology, but it is not a drug discovery method or clinically validated treatment strategy.
method: Represent patient differences as hidden context in a contextual Markov decision process.
Learn policies robust to biomarker measurement errors and uncertain disease dynamics.
Evaluate adaptive therapy policies in a simulator calibrated to clinical data.
evidence_signal: In simulation, the robust policies Pareto-dominated the existing method across diverse scenarios, with almost no performance loss under accurate biomarkers and anticipated disease dynamics.
watch_item: Simulator-based results require prospective clinical validation before patient-care use.
paper_title: Robust Reinforcement Learning for Dynamic Treatment Regimes under Model and Measurement Uncertainty
